### ① Derived judgments

1. **FAIL-1 of the prior review — fixed exactly.** `triage-duties.md` L5 on the head reads 「- 发版板、pin 链归总监席摘要,细则见 director.md;活性复查同归,细则留本文;⛔ 无代裁通道。」 — byte-identical to the fix the prior review asked for (119 B, file still 103/103). The PR body's `triage-duties.md` row now says 「line 5 names where the release board and pin chain went (总监席 digest, details now in `lanes/director.md`) and that the in-flight liveness re-check goes to the same digest with its details staying here」 — the 「details staying here」 claim is now attached only to the liveness re-check, which is the one block that did stay (L71–L73). RIGHT.
2. **Ruling A written in, nothing else.** Card #25414 comment 6369035432 (maintainer 「25422 同意」 2026-10-23T15:55:37Z, batch #7 item 2, letter A) gives the suggested text 「过渡:无另一账户在席时,① 的替代 = 维护者本人在执行线程的话:逐个点名 PR 编号,或对该席位的 Tier S 长期授权(一句可撤)。」. The head's `contract-review.md` L41–L42 read 「- 过渡:无另一账户在席时,① 的替代 = 维护者本人在执行线程的话:逐个点名 PR 编号,」 (110 B) and 「  或对该席位的 Tier S 长期授权(一句可撤)。」 (57 B); with the list marker and the continuation indent removed, the two lines concatenate to the ruling's sentence character for character. The wrap falls after the comma that separates the two alternatives, so the rule reads as one sentence with two disjuncts under one condition (「无另一账户在席时」); the ruling's 「it lapses once another account's `Reviewed-by:` review of record is available」 is carried by that same condition. The ruling's 「line count unchanged」 is a wording estimate — the sentence does not fit in 120 B on one line, so the file goes 53 → 54 against ceiling 60. The diff since `f0f3de9` contains nothing beyond these two edits. RIGHT.
3. **Everything else the prior full review held** — items 1–6 of card #25414 (独立性对 + `Reviewed-by-account:` matching the #25436 guard key; 落地前检 placed in `contract-review.md`; `pm:mailbox` line; runbook 〈巡查常设项〉 and the cross-account review pass; thin triage in `lanes/triage.md` with every moved block having a named home; decision cards staying in their filing repo with the 总监席 all-repo scan; no login in any rule line) — is unchanged on this head (`git diff f0f3de9..3e07aa8` is limited to the two lines above) and passes by reference to that review.

Surface, budgets, merge on this head: 8 files changed, the same 7 reference files plus the ratchet's ceiling rows; `SKILL.md` untouched (318 on the head); no Tier H path (`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `docs/**`, `skills/**`, `.github/workflows/**` untouched); no `scripts/**` other than the ratchet. Budgets (wc -l / ceiling): `contract-review.md` 54/60, `cross-repo-coordination.md` 51/51, `dispatch-runbook.md` 241/241, `landing-operations.md` 101/101, `lanes/director.md` 87/87, `lanes/triage.md` 7/7, `triage-duties.md` 103/103; widest line in every touched file 120 B, no added line over 120 B. Ratchet on the head: exit 0, the declared cross-file move reported as 「+17 (70→87) against a net source decrease of 17 (triage-duties.md 120→103)」, total ceilings down 488; id-lint 87 files clean; frame-sync and frame-freshness pass. Human floor: `main` `triage-duties.md` L95–L120 vs head L78–L103 byte-identical (裁决恒归维护者人工, 人工地板, 风险判据, 工作量判据, 不呈, 例外一/二). `git grep -n 'os-bill\|hotlong\|os-elon-musk' -- .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/` on the head: no hit. Merge: `git merge-tree --write-tree` of the head onto the current `origin/main` `05cc3ee9533a7e9076a439cfd3aeb9b606edcda7` (two refactor commits after the base, both outside `.claude/**`) is clean, and with open PR #25474's head `c246fb07b1c60e62e82c944d2b69a20efa3957f1` (`contract-review.md` +1, `coordinator.md`, runbook, `execution-duties.md`) is clean — no overlapping hunks.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` correct: `.claude/**` and one script under `scripts/pm/` move no published package. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` match a rule-text-only diff. No changeset owed. PR body consistent with the head: the 维护者速读 states the ruling (「批 #7 卡 2 裁定 A」, 「您 15:55Z 的「25422 同意」已裁定过渡行」) and the 「你要做的」 line correctly says no further per-PR naming is needed under the 14:14Z standing word; the line-budget table (54/60, 103/103, 87/87) matches wc -l; the Gates paragraph names the head `3e07aa8`. One stale figure, not a rule claim: 「`SKILL.md` untouched (319/319)」 beside 「Post-merge counts: `SKILL.md` 318」 — the head has 318; cosmetic.

### ③ Boundary flags

- ③-0 **Same-account review.** This record is rendered by an isolated subagent of the `domain:skills` seat 2 under account `os-elon-musk`, the same login as the PR body's attribution `github_login`; by the head's own text 「同账户子代理只算复核」 it is a review, not the review of record. Under the ruling A text now on the head (「…或对该席位的 Tier S 长期授权(一句可撤)」), the maintainer's standing Tier S word for this seat — 2026-10-23T14:14Z in the skills seat thread, 「后续按 pm-dispatch 规则审核通过的都可以落地」 — is the ① substitute for landing this PR; comment 6369035432 says the same (「no further per-PR naming is needed for it」). The prior ③-1 (two readings of the interim rule) is resolved by that ruling and dropped.
- ③-2 The card's item 1 names two sources of the author's account (the attribution `github_login` line 「and the relay sender」); the head reads the body line only and the record states the reviewer's account (`Reviewed-by-account:`), the author's being machine-read from the body — what #25436 can read. Accepted as the implementable half; the gap stays visible.
- ③-3 Out-of-surface text now stale (`seat-post-protocol.md` L28 / L80, `seat-lifecycle.md` L39 / L76, `check-half-states.mjs` prescription string 「四仓全量对账」, `cross-repo-coordination.md` L7 「定级的唯一生产者」) — carried by card #25490 for the seat's follow-up; unchanged by this delta.
- ③-4 PR author is `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (opened through the relay); the body's first line is the project attribution HTML comment, reported by the thread itself as a deviation from `os-dev.md` 〈干净收尾〉.
